subject: Evaluate widget from which the input is generated (in server.R)

messages.author: 21f3ea565bf0101a
messages.subject: Evaluate widget from which the input is generated (in server.R)
parts:
Is it possible to find out (in server) what type of widget created the input (i.e. I'd be interested to find out if a received text (input$text) was created from a selectInput or a radioButton.

You might ask why I would be interested in this. In my app I try to come up with a very general way to update widgets. 


Since different widgets have different update*-functions (i.e updateSelectInput or updateRadioButton) this would be a valuable information.

Any ideas how this could be implemented in a generic way?
